name: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Sealed-tick iterated Rock Paper Scissors. Each round both players SECRETLY pick rock, paper, or scissors; reveals happen simultaneously. Standard win rules: rock crushes scissors, scissors cuts paper, paper covers rock. Tied rounds award no points. Match is best-of-N — first player to reach the win threshold takes the match. Configure N from 1 (single round) up to 99 (long iterated match). Skill comes from pattern detection and randomness generation. Chat is ENABLED — players can talk trash and try to bluff each other; speech reveals alongside the move so it can't leak the pick.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Both players submit one move per round. Round resolves when both have submitted.

entity_types.name: RPSPlayer
entity_types.description: A Rock Paper Scissors player. Sees their own move history, opponent's move history (after reveals), and the running score. Picks ONE move per round: 'rock', 'paper', or 'scissors'.

properties.name: randomness
properties.description: 0 = leans on detectable patterns (favorite move, periodic switches); 1 = tries to play uniformly random.

properties.name: counter_seeking
properties.description: 0 = ignores opponent history; 1 = aggressively counters opponent's most-frequent / most-recent move.

actions.name: throw
actions.description: Submit your move for the current round. REQUIRED parameter `move` — one of 'rock', 'paper', 'scissors' (case-insensitive). Sealed: your opponent does NOT see your pick until both have submitted. After both submit, both reveals happen simultaneously. Rock crushes scissors; scissors cuts paper; paper covers rock; identical moves tie (no point awarded).

agent_archetypes.name: Pattern Hunter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Reads opponent's move history aggressively. Tracks frequency, recent streaks, and 'switch-after-loss' patterns; plays the counter to the predicted next move. Wins big against predictable opponents; loses to true randomness.

agent_archetypes.name: Randomizer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Tries to play maximally random — no patterns, no opponent-reads, just uniform 1/3 on every move. Hard to exploit; relies on opponent making mistakes.

agent_archetypes.name: Frequency Counter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Tracks opponent's TOTAL frequency across the match. If opponent has thrown more rock than paper or scissors, plays paper. Doesn't react to short-term streaks. Steady, exploitable by adaptive opponents.

agent_archetypes.name: Streaker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Loves streaks — once they pick a move, they repeat it for 2-4 rounds in a row before switching. Hopes the opponent over-adapts after one round. Wins fast on hot streaks; punished by anyone who notices.

agent_archetypes.name: Win-Stay-Lose-Shift
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Classic conditional rule — if last round won, repeat the same move; if lost or tied, shift to a different move. A famously decent baseline against humans, exploitable in pure theory.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Rock Paper Scissors is strictly 2 players.

runtime_parameters.name: best_of
runtime_parameters.label: Best of (rounds)
runtime_parameters.description: Match length. The first player to reach ceil(best_of/2) round wins takes the match. Odd values guarantee no overall tie. Higher N rewards pattern detection over single-round luck.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'world championship' or 'duel to settle a wager'.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player reaches the win threshold.
